name: [TV3] WF-04: Weekly Morale & Executive Sentiment Digest

parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(d.name, 'Chưa phân phòng') AS dept_name, em.mood, COUNT(*) AS count FROM employee_moods em JOIN users u ON em.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN departments d ON u.department_id = d.id WHERE em.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) GROUP BY dept_name, em.mood;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM onboarding_tasks t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.is_completed = 0 AND u.is_active = 1 AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), u.created_at) > t.due_day) AS total_overdue_tasks, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM employee_moods WHERE is_burnout_risk = 1 AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)) AS burnout_flags, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'EMPLOYEE' AND is_active = 1) AS active_employees, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM employee_moods WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)) AS participants, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee_moods WHERE mood = 'GREAT' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 7 DAY) AND created_at < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)) AS prev_great, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee_moods WHERE mood = 'NORMAL' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 7 DAY) AND created_at < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)) AS prev_normal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee_moods WHERE mood = 'STRESSED' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 7 DAY) AND created_at < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)) AS prev_stressed;

=INSERT INTO morale_reports (week_start, company_score, total_checkins, participation_pct, great_pct, normal_pct, stressed_pct, overdue_tasks, burnout_flags) VALUES ('{{ $('Morale Analytics Engine').first().json.weekStart }}', {{ $('Morale Analytics Engine').first().json.score ?? 'NULL' }}, {{ $('Morale Analytics Engine').first().json.totalCheckins }}, {{ $('Morale Analytics Engine').first().json.participationPct ?? 'NULL' }}, {{ $('Morale Analytics Engine').first().json.greatPct }}, {{ $('Morale Analytics Engine').first().json.normalPct }}, {{ $('Morale Analytics Engine').first().json.stressedPct }}, {{ $('Morale Analytics Engine').first().json.overdueTasks }}, {{ $('Morale Analytics Engine').first().json.burnoutFlags }}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE company_score = VALUES(company_score), total_checkins = VALUES(total_checkins), participation_pct = VALUES(participation_pct), great_pct = VALUES(great_pct), normal_pct = VALUES(normal_pct), stressed_pct = VALUES(stressed_pct), overdue_tasks = VALUES(overdue_tasks), burnout_flags = VALUES(burnout_flags);
